prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a village market at dawn. On the far left, an old woman in a blue shawl stands beside a woven basket of apples. A brown dog sits next to her, looking up expectantly. In the center foreground, a young boy in a striped shirt points at a bright orange pumpkin resting on a wooden crate. The vendor, a man with a thick beard, hands a small coin to the boy while smiling. Behind them, a white goat leans against a stack of hay bales, chewing lazily. To the right of the goat, a girl in a yellow dress holds a red balloon that floats slightly above her head. A black cat perches on top of a nearby barrel, watching the balloon intently. Further back on the right, a farmer in overalls loads a sack of grain onto a donkey. The donkey stands patiently, its ears perked forward. Next to the donkey, a bicycle leans against a stone wall, its front wheel turned slightly. An elderly man in a flat cap sits on a low stool near the bicycle, tying his shoelaces. Above him, a flock of three sparrows flies past a hanging lantern. In the background center, a tall sunflower grows from a cracked pot, towering over the scene. There is no modern signage visible anywhere in the market. There is no electronic equipment present among the stalls.
